svg.title: How strands-robots is layered: a Strands Agent, policies, backends and robots. Actions flow down, observations flow up; sim and hardware share every layer above them.
svg.text: One Python API. One tool per robot. Policies and backends plug in; sim and hardware share every layer above them.
Agent(tools=[robot]): natural-language goals, one tool per robot, operator approval before real motion
Policy ABC: observation in, action chunk out. create_policy(provider) picks the model or the planner
SimEngine ABC or a hardware driver: the same send_action, the same observation, mode decides which
registry/robots.json: arms, hands, bimanual rigs, humanoids, quadrupeds, mobile bases; assets download on first use
